decision.explanation: Two distinct houses named 'Kidd House' are mentioned in the provided sources. The Kidd House in Lavonia, Georgia (D1S1–D1S3), is stated to have been designed by architect Leila Ross Wilburn (D1S3). Separately, the McCurry-Kidd House in Hartwell, Georgia (D4S1–D4S8, D5S1–D5S7) is attributed to architect Willis Irwin (D4S8, D5S1). These are separate properties with distinct architects. Both answers are valid and non-conflicting when the referents are correctly disambiguated.
